IClosedAPIKeyCredential.title: ICLOSED API Key
IClosedAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: In iClosed, open Settings → Developer → API Keys. Create a key and paste the complete key, including its iclosed_ prefix, without Bearer. The key acts as its user and account. Connection checks read your contacts; write permissions are checked by iClosed when used.
